claims.claim: 心肌梗死的晨间发生率约为深夜的 3 倍，与晨间血压升高、血小板聚集增强一致。
claims.supportQuote: Studies found that the incidence of MI is three times higher in the morning compared to late evening.
claims.applicability: 描述心肌梗死发生的时间分布，用于说明晨间聚集现象；不涉及排便动作的因果归因。
claims.uncertainty: 综述引用他人研究；晨间聚集可被觉醒时点、服药与活动量等混杂解释。

claims.sourceTitle: Circadian variation pattern of sudden cardiac arrest occurred in Chinese community
claims.supportQuote: Among 10 210 cases of SCA, major cases (8736, 85.6%) were non-shockable and 1474 (14.4%) cases were shockable. The circadian rhythm of SCA was as follows: peak time was from 08:00 to 11:59 (30.1%), while deep valley was from 00:00 to 03:59 (7.5%).
claims.applicability: 中国社区人群心源性猝死的时间分布；描述性证据，仅支持时间分布不均。
claims.uncertainty: 观察性数据，未校正觉醒时点、晨间活动量；时间分布不等于排便触发的因果证据。

claims.claim: 丹麦匹配队列 83 239 例便秘患者与 832 384 例对照中，便秘与心肌梗死的校正风险比为 1.24（95% CI 1.14～1.35）。
claims.sourceTitle: Constipation and risk of cardiovascular diseases: a Danish population-based matched cohort study
claims.supportQuote: 83 239 patients with constipation were matched to 832 384 individuals without constipation. … Constipation was also associated with arterial events, including myocardial infarction (1.24, 95% CI 1.14 to 1.35)
claims.applicability: 慢性便秘（持续状态）与长期随访心肌梗死事件的关联，非单次排便动作的急性触发；丹麦人群。
claims.uncertainty: 观察性队列，存在未测混杂（体力活动、饮食）；E 值 1.79 提示该关联相对稳健但仍属慢性暴露关联。

claims.sourceTitle: Constipation and risk of cardiovascular diseases: a Danish population-based matched cohort study
claims.supportQuote: Constipation was strongly associated with venous thromboembolism (aHR 2.04, 95% CI 1.89 to 2.20) … ischaemic stroke (1.50, 95% CI 1.41 to 1.60), haemorrhagic stroke (1.46, 95% CI 1.26 to 1.69) … heart failure (1.52, 95% CI 1.42 to 1.62)
claims.applicability: 慢性便秘与多类心血管结局的关联；静脉性事件关联强于动脉性。
claims.uncertainty: 观察性；静脉血栓关联更强提示制动等机制混杂的可能性。

claims.claim: 便秘与心血管事件的关联在诊断后首年最强（心肌梗死约 1.5 倍），且随泻剂处方强度增加而增强；心肌梗死估计的 E 值为 1.79。
claims.sourceTitle: Constipation and risk of cardiovascular diseases: a Danish population-based matched cohort study
claims.supportQuote: The excess risk of cardiovascular disease was highest during the first year following the diagnosis of constipation, with a 1.5-fold increased risk of myocardial infarction … For myocardial infarction (aHR 1.24, 95% CI 1.14 to 1.35), the E-value was 1.79
claims.applicability: 关联的时序与强度特征；泻剂剂量-反应更可能反映便秘严重程度这一混杂。
claims.uncertainty: 诊断后首年高峰与泻剂剂量-反应不排除反向因果与疾病严重度混杂。

claims.claim: 纳入 13 项研究、3 710 453 名参与者的荟萃分析显示，便秘与全因死亡相关（HR 1.10，95% CI 1.02–1.19），而一般人群的心血管死亡相关（HR 1.19，95% CI 0.99–1.45）未达统计学显著。
claims.sourceTitle: Association between constipation and risk of cardiovascular or all-cause mortality: a meta-analysis
claims.supportQuote: Thirteen studies (14 articles) involving 3,710,453 participants were included. Pooled analyses revealed a significant association between constipation and all-cause mortality across different populations: a HR of 1.10 (95% CI 1.02–1.19) for the general population … Conversely, no significant associations were observed for cardiovascular mortality in either the general population (HR 1.19; 95% CI 0.99–1.45)
claims.applicability: 便秘与死亡结局的合并估计；一般人群心血管死亡相关不显著，削弱因果解释。
claims.uncertainty: 便秘定义异质性大，随机效应模型；研究间异质性与发表偏倚可能影响估计。

claims.claim: 澳大利亚 541172 例 60 岁以上住院患者中，便秘与心肌梗死的校正比值比为 1.10（95% CI 1.09–1.12），与高血压的比值比为 1.96（1.94–1.99）。
claims.sourceTitle: Association of constipation with increased risk of hypertension and cardiovascular events in elderly Australian patients
claims.supportQuote: This population-level matched cohort study compared the association of constipation with hypertension and incident cardiovascular events in 541,172 hospitalized patients aged ≥ 60 years. … Patients with constipation had a higher multivariate-adjusted risk for hypertension (odds ratio [OR], 1.96; 95% confidence interval [CI] 1.94–1.99; P < 0.001). … myocardial infarction (OR, 1.10; 95% CI 1.09–1.12; P < 0.001
claims.applicability: 60 岁以上住院人群的横断面关联；仅支持相关性，不能推断时序。
claims.uncertainty: 住院人群选择偏倚；logistic 回归为横断面设计，因果方向不可辨。

claims.claim: 便秘导致排便用力，而排便用力与血压的瞬时升高相关，被队列研究引为便秘-心血管关联的机制解释之一。
claims.sourceTitle: Constipation and risk of cardiovascular diseases: a Danish population-based matched cohort study
claims.supportQuote: Constipation leads to straining at stool, which has been associated with transient increases in blood pressure.
claims.applicability: 机制性陈述，支持排便用力与血压瞬时升高之间的生理联系；不构成事件层面的因果证据。
claims.uncertainty: 为作者提出的解释性机制而非实测终点。

claims.claim: 174 例对长效硝酸酯不耐受的慢性冠脉综合征患者的多中心随机双盲安慰剂对照试验报告，速效救心丸组 4 周有效率为 60.9%，安慰剂组为 39.1%（OR 2.43，95% CI 1.32～4.47，P=0.004）。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and Safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pills in the Treatment of Chronic Coronary Syndrome with Intolerance to Adverse Effects of Long-acting Nitrates
claims.supportQuote: A total of 174 CCS participants from eight clinical study centers in China were included in the modified intention-to-treat analyses. … Participants with CCS and intolerance to the adverse effects of long-acting nitrates were recruited and randomized to either the SJPs or the placebo group for a duration of 4 weeks. … Specifically, 60.9% of patients treated with SJPs achieved a 20-point or greater improvement in SAQ-SS, while only 39.1% (OR = 2.43, 95% confidence interval [CI] = 1.32 to 4.47, P = 0.004) of patients in the placebo group achieved the same level of improvement
claims.applicability: 已确诊慢性冠脉综合征（稳定型心绞痛谱系）患者的慢性疗程症状量表结局，非急性事件、非未分化胸痛自救。
claims.uncertainty: 4 周短疗程、单个试验、样本量 174 例；结局为症状量表而非心血管事件。

claims.claim: 速效救心丸为含川芎（Ligusticum chuanxiong）与冰片（Borneolum syntheticum）的中成药，1982 年经国家药监部门批准。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and Safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pills in the Treatment of Chronic Coronary Syndrome with Intolerance to Adverse Effects of Long-acting Nitrates
claims.supportQuote: Suxiao Jiuxin Pill (SJPs) emerges as a prominent traditional Chinese patent medicine utilized for the treatment of acute ischemic heart disease, which was approved by China Food and Drug Administration (CFDA) in 1982 … The pill is composed of Ligusticum striatum DC. … Chuanxiong Rhizoma) and Dryobalanops aromatica C.F.Gaertn. … Borneolum syntheticum).
claims.applicability: 药物组成与批准信息，用于界定本品身份与适应症背景。
claims.uncertainty: 由随机对照试验引言转述，非监管文本原文。

claims.claim: 纳入 41 项随机对照试验、6276 例患者的荟萃分析报告，速效救心丸改善冠心病心电图表现（RR 1.32，95% CI 1.26～1.38），与硝酸甘油比较为 RR 1.35（1.16～1.56）。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: Forty-one trials involving 6276 patients were included in our analysis. Administration of suxiao jiuxin pill significantly improved electrocardiogram (ECG) results when compared with other therapies (RR 1.32, 95% CI 1.26 to 1.38, and P < 0.001). … nitroglycerin (RR 1.35, 95% CI 1.16 to 1.56, and P < 0.001)
claims.applicability: 已确诊冠心病人群的替代终点（心电图），纳入研究多为小样本单中心。
claims.uncertainty: 替代终点非临床事件；纳入试验方法学质量有限，异质性高。

claims.claim: 针对气滞血瘀型稳定型心绞痛的随机双盲安慰剂对照试验方案拟纳入 324 例、疗程 24 周，以心绞痛症状改善率与主要不良心血管事件（MACE）为共同主要终点，结果尚未见刊。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill in the treatment of stable angina (Qi stagnation and blood stasis syndrome): study protocol
claims.supportQuote: The trial will enroll 324 participants with chronic stable angina (Qi Stagnation and Blood Stasis syndrome). … in addition to conventional treatment for 24 weeks … The primary outcomes are the symptom improvement rate of angina from baseline to 4 weeks after inclusion and major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE).
claims.applicability: 界定速效救心丸的研究人群为气滞血瘀型稳定型心绞痛；事件终点试验尚在进行。
claims.uncertainty: 为研究方案而非结果，不能作为疗效证据。

claims.claim: 速效救心丸通过川芎嗪与冰片等成分对人动脉产生舒张、抑制收缩作用。
claims.sourceTitle: Suxiao Jiuxin Pill Induces Potent Relaxation and Inhibition on Contraction in Human Artery and the Mechanism
claims.supportQuote: Suxiao Jiuxin Pill, a compound Chinese traditional medicine with main components of tetramethylpyrazine and borneol … SJP has a potent inhibitory effect on the vasoconstriction mediated by a variety of vasoconstrictors in human arteries.
claims.applicability: 离体人血管的机制证据，支持血管舒张方向；不构成临床事件证据。
claims.uncertainty: 体外实验，外推至人体事件需谨慎。

claims.claim: 韩国急性心肌梗死注册中 4874 例 STEMI 患者仅 28.4% 在症状发生后 60 分钟内到院，急救医疗服务（EMS）使用率为 21.7%，且 EMS 是唯一与 60 分钟内到院相关的因素。
claims.sourceTitle: Pre-hospital delay and emergency medical services in acute myocardial infarction
claims.supportQuote: A total of 4,874 patients were included in the analysis, of whom 28.4% arrived at the hospital within 60 minutes of symptom-onset. … Utilising EMS was the only factor shown to reduce STDT within 60 minutes … The overall frequency of EMS utilisation was low (21.7%).
claims.applicability: 说明缩短就医延迟的关键环节在 EMS 激活；不直接支持药物摆放位置策略。
claims.uncertainty: 观察性注册，韩国情境；未检验自救药物放置位置或可及性。

claims.claim: 纳入 18 项教育干预、180 914 名参与者的系统评价显示，10 项干预对主要结局无显著作用，其余干预将院前延迟缩短 17～324 分钟（中位 40 分钟），成功部分来源于急救医疗服务使用率的提高。
claims.sourceTitle: A systematic review of educational interventions aiming to reduce prehospital delay in patients with acute coronary syndrome
claims.supportQuote: We found 18 educational interventions with a total of 180 914 participants … Ten studies yielded no significant effects on the primary outcome while the remaining interventions reported a significant reduction with a decrease between 17 and 324 min (median reduction: 40 min, n=5). The success was partly driven by an increase in emergency medical services use.
claims.applicability: 减少院前延迟的干预证据指向 EMS 激活而非药物摆放位置。
claims.uncertainty: 干预异质性大、方法学缺陷，无法给出确定性推荐。

claims.claim: 2021 年 AHA/ACC 胸痛评估与诊断指南将胸、肩、臂、颈、背、上腹或下颌的疼痛、压迫、紧缩或不适以及气促、乏力列为心绞痛的等同症状，并要求以循证诊断路径进行结构化风险评估。
claims.sourceTitle: 2021 Guideline for the Evaluation and Diagnosis of Chest Pain (Professional Heart Daily)
claims.supportQuote: Chest Pain Means More Than Pain in the Chest. Pain, pressure, tightness, or discomfort in the chest, shoulders, arms, neck, back, upper abdomen, or jaw, as well as shortness of breath and fatigue should all be considered anginal equivalents. … Structured Risk Assessment Should Be Used. For patients presenting with acute or stable chest pain, risk for coronary artery disease and adverse events should be estimated using evidence-based diagnostic protocols.
claims.applicability: 胸痛症状谱界定与结构化评估的官方摘要；用于胸痛升级路径。
claims.uncertainty: 为指南官方摘要页（Top Things to Know），非完整推荐文本与推荐等级。

claims.claim: 英国 NHS 指引将胸痛持续不缓解、放射至臂/颈/下颌/上腹/背部、或伴出汗、恶心、头晕、气促列为立即呼叫急救的条件。
claims.supportQuote: Immediate action required: Call 999 if: … you get sudden pain or discomfort in your chest that does not go away … you get pain that spreads to your left or right arm, or your neck, jaw, stomach or back … you have chest pain and you feel sweaty, sick, light headed or short of breath … You could be having a heart attack. Call 999 straight away as you need immediate treatment in hospital.
claims.applicability: 面向公众的急救呼叫条件，可直接映射至中国 120 的呼叫情境。
claims.uncertainty: 英国公共健康指引；中国情境以 120 对应，具体分流遵循国内指南。

claims.claim: 若心源性猝死在 24 小时内均匀分布，08:00～11:59 的 4 小时应占约 16.7%（4/24），实际为 30.1%，约为均匀假设的 1.8 倍。
claims.method: 将 4 小时窗口在 24 小时中的均匀占比计算为 4/24 = 0.1667，即 16.7%；再用观察到的晨间占比 30.1% 除以 16.7%，得 30.1/16.7 ≈ 1.8，作为晨间时段的相对聚集倍数。
claims.assumptions: 假设事件在一天内均匀分布时各 4 小时窗口占比相等，以此作为无聚集的基准；观察到的 30.1% 来自中国社区 10 210 例心源性猝死在 08:00～11:59 时段内的占比。
claims.sensitivity: 若采用 1 小时或 8 小时窗口，倍数会相应变化；该倍数仅描述晨间时段聚集程度，不涉及排便动作是否为原因。
claims.applicability: 量化晨间时段的聚集程度，用于讨论事件时间分布而非因果。
claims.uncertainty: 均匀分布基准是简化假设；未校正觉醒、服药、活动量等混杂。
